fire_rule: Let y_t be the number of mechanism keys first seen at 1-based source index t. Fire at the smallest t >= min_sources such that mean(y_{t-window+1} .. y_t) <= floor. Silent if no such t exists.
miss_rate_definition: If the detector fires at t*, miss_count is the number of mechanism keys whose first-seen index is > t*. miss_rate = miss_count / total_distinct_at_end. If the detector never fires, both are null (no stop, so no post-stop miss).
citation: Catalog RES-0151: stopping metric = marginal rate of NEW distinct claims per additional source; distinctness is mechanism-level, not string equality. Floor 0.4 is one new distinct mechanism per 2.5 sources. Window equals min_sources so the first eligible decision uses a full window. These numbers were frozen before any historical replay or control corpus was scored on this worktree.
